# Feature: Compare baseline

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #28 -->

## Intent
Hard Compare evaluates baseline vs candidate only when scenario, profile, adapter major, runtime class, hardware class, and build mode match. Otherwise the result is `non-comparable`, never a budget-fail. A new baseline is written only after explicit confirm for a completed, valid run; the previous baseline id stays in history.

## Preconditions
- Analysis engine (#6) and run detail (#24)
- Golden artifact `01J9GOLDENV100000000000000`

## Happy Path
- [x] Incompatible lockedInputs/fingerprints → `non-comparable`, not budget-fail
- [x] Compatible compare shows absolute values, delta, and noise budget
- [x] Baseline set requires `--confirm` / Confirm and completed+valid
- [x] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [x] Debug vs release is non-comparable (EDGE-007)
- [x] Dirty git is visible on the fingerprint and does not by itself block compare
- [x] Confirm without the flag / button writes nothing

## Regression
- [x] Existing analysis T-007 tests still pass
- [x] CLI `ci` remains a stub
- [x] Token not in localStorage

## Assumptions
- Noise budget default is 5% relative delta (PRD NFR-004)
- Frame-time metrics treat lower as better
- Compatible/incompatible candidates are served by the local API next to the golden run
- UI copy is English

## Security Coverage
- F-02: compare body validated (run ids)
- F-03: token stays in memory
- B-03: compare and baseline POST require the run token
- B-02: baseline write is confirm-gated
- F-01 waived (loopback)
- Out of scope: B-04, P-04

## Implementation Notes
- `compareRuns` in `packages/analysis` checks scenario/profile/adapter-major/runtime.node/host.arch+os.name/build.mode. Git dirty is a visible note, not a lock miss.
- Compatible regression → CLI exit 1. Non-comparable → exit 4, never 1.
- `potato compare --set-baseline --confirm` writes `.potato/baselines.json` and historises the previous id. Without `--confirm`, no write.
- Local API: `POST /api/v1/compare`, `GET/POST /api/v1/baselines`. Fixtures: golden, compatible candidate (p95=50), debug candidate.
- Dashboard `/compare`: Compare table + Confirm baseline disabled until a comparable candidate is compared.

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
- Event: two artifacts → one comparison result; baseline confirm is one write with history of the previous id.
- N-actors: 1 compare request → N metric rows; fail-closed only when comparable AND regressed.
- Invalid: missing artifact 404; cancelled run cannot become baseline; debug vs release is non-comparable.
- Two consumers: CLI file compare and dashboard POST share `compareRuns`.
